title: Assent and Operational Decentralization under the Electricity Act 2023
summary: President Bola Ahmed Tinubu signed the Electricity Act 2023 into law, repealing the 2005 EPSRA and empowering federating states to establish independent electricity regulatory commissions, license sub-national generation, and unbundle regional distribution networks.
responsible_institutions: Federal Ministry of Power|Nigerian Electricity Regulatory Commission|State House
reported_outcomes: Transfer of regulatory oversight to multiple State Electricity Regulatory Commissions including Ondo, Ekiti, Enugu, and Imo
notes: Foundational statutory reform decentralizing Nigeria electricity supply industry

title: Unification of Foreign Exchange Windows and Transition to Market-Determined Rate
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria unified multiple official foreign exchange rate windows into the Nigerian Autonomous Foreign Exchange Market (NAFEM), abolishing discretionary pegging to enhance market transparency and foreign capital inflow.
responsible_institutions: Central Bank of Nigeria|Federal Ministry of Finance
reported_outcomes: Elimination of official FX arbitrage gap and multi-billion dollar recovery in net foreign portfolio investments
notes: Monetary reform verified by CBN operational circulars and World Bank development reviews

title: Federal Inland Revenue Service Non-Oil Tax Revenue Mobilization Expansion
summary: The Federal Inland Revenue Service (FIRS) achieved historic non-oil revenue collections exceeding N12.3 trillion in 2023 and sustained collection growth into 2024 through digital tax automation and VAT efficiency.
responsible_institutions: Federal Inland Revenue Service|Federal Ministry of Finance
reported_outcomes: Record non-oil revenue collections representing over 100 percent of fiscal collection target
notes: Documented in FIRS statutory annual performance bulletin and NBS fiscal statistics

title: Establishment and Operational Deployment of the Presidential Compressed Natural Gas Initiative
summary: The Presidential Compressed Natural Gas (Pi-CNG) initiative was inaugurated to mitigate transport costs post-subsidy removal by deploying commercial conversion kits, establishing certified refueling stations, and distributing high-capacity CNG mass transit buses.
responsible_institutions: Presidency|PCNGi Steering Committee|Federal Ministry of Transportation
reported_outcomes: Commissioning of 15 commercial conversion centres and delivery of pilot CNG passenger buses
notes: Direct physical intervention documented in State House briefings and commercial transport logs

title: Presidential Executive Order 040 on Upstream Oil and Gas Fiscal Incentives
summary: Presidential assent to Executive Orders 40, 41, and 42 introducing zero-tariff exemptions, contracting cycle compression from 36 to 6 months, and fiscal tax credits for non-associated gas greenfield developments.
responsible_institutions: Presidency|Special Adviser on Energy|NUPRC
reported_outcomes: Over USD 5 billion in accelerated final investment decision commitments unlocked across deepwater and shallow assets
notes: Published in Federal Republic of Nigeria Official Gazette and affirmed by NUPRC

title: National Food Security Emergency Declaration and Strategic Grain Reserve Offload
summary: President Tinubu declared a national state of emergency on food security, directing the unconditional release of 42,000 metric tonnes of maize, sorghum, and millet from the National Strategic Food Reserve to vulnerable households across 36 states.
responsible_institutions: Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security|National Emergency Management Agency
reported_outcomes: 42000 MT of grain distributed through state emergency committees to mitigate inflationary pressure
notes: Documented in Ministry of Agriculture release manifest and state distribution records

title: Launch of the National Dry-Season Wheat Cultivation Initiative in Northern Agro-Corridors
summary: Under the National Agricultural Growth Scheme and Agro-Pocket (NAGS-AP), the Federal Government launched a 120,000-hectare dry-season wheat production programme providing 50% subsidized certified seeds, fertilizers, and agrochemicals to over 107,000 farmers.
responsible_institutions: Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security|African Development Bank
reported_outcomes: Over 107000 smallholder wheat farmers cultivated 120000 hectares producing an estimated 400000 metric tonnes
notes: Supported by AfDB NAGS-AP facility with verified electronic redemption vouchers

title: Bilateral Activation of the Green Imperative Agricultural Mechanization Scheme
summary: Bilateral financing activation with the German and Brazilian export credit agencies for the USD 1.1 billion Green Imperative Project to establish 959 agricultural service centres and assemble 10,000 tractors nationwide.
responsible_institutions: Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security|Federal Ministry of Finance
reported_outcomes: Cabinet approval and sovereign credit structuring for nationwide tractor assembly centres
notes: FEC resolution and bilateral sovereign facility execution

title: Launch and Phase 1 Deployment of the 3 Million Technical Talent (3MTT) Programme
summary: The Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy launched the 3MTT initiative, training and certifying over 30,000 fellows in Phase 1 across 12 digital tech disciplines and placing over 10,000 into internships and jobs.
responsible_institutions: Federal Ministry of Communications Innovation and Digital Economy|NITDA
reported_outcomes: 30000 cohort-1 graduates across 36 states with multi-million naira training support grants
notes: Documented in NITDA dashboard metrics and IHS Towers fellowship partnership

title: Federal Executive Council Approval of the 90,000km National Fiber Backbone Special Purpose Vehicle
summary: The Federal Executive Council approved the establishment of a dedicated Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) to co-invest and deploy 90,000 kilometres of terrestrial fiber-optic broadband infrastructure nationwide.
responsible_institutions: Federal Ministry of Communications Innovation and Digital Economy|FEC
reported_outcomes: Establishment of SPV to increase national fiber footprint from 35000km to 125000km
notes: FEC approval extract and ministerial briefing documented

title: Inauguration of the National Council for Digital Innovation and Entrepreneurship
summary: President Tinubu inaugurated the statutory National Council for Digital Innovation and Entrepreneurship (NCDIE) to formally operationalize the Nigeria Startup Act 2022 and oversee the N10 Billion Startup Investment Fund.
responsible_institutions: Presidency|Federal Ministry of Communications Innovation and Digital Economy
reported_outcomes: Council inaugurated with public-private participation to administer regulatory sandboxes and tax reliefs
notes: State House communique and gazetted charter

title: Construction and Pavement Engineering on the 700km Lagos-Calabar Coastal Highway (Section 1)
summary: Federal Ministry of Works awarded and commenced construction on the 47.47km Section 1 (Ahmadu Bello Way Victoria Island to Eleko Beach) of the 10-lane Lagos-Calabar Coastal Highway using continuously reinforced concrete pavement (CRCP).
responsible_institutions: Federal Ministry of Works|Hitech Construction Company Ltd
reported_outcomes: Pavement sandfilling, bridge foundation piling, and dual-carriageway concrete paving on first 10km
notes: On-site verified civil engineering progress documented by Ministry of Works inspections

title: Rehabilitation and Commercial Operations Recommencement of the Abuja Light Rail (Metro) Network
summary: President Tinubu commissioned the rehabilitated 27.2km Abuja Light Rail (Lot 1B and Lot 3) with 12 modern train stations and approved two months of free passenger operations for FCT commuters.
responsible_institutions: Federal Capital Territory Administration|Federal Ministry of Transportation
reported_outcomes: Full commercial operations resumed across Abuja Metro with daily passenger ridership exceeding 15000
notes: Presidential commissioning and FCTA transportation operational logs

title: Recommencement of Commercial Passenger and Freight Rail Operations on Port Harcourt - Aba Corridor
summary: The Nigerian Railway Corporation completed track rehabilitation and recommenced scheduled commercial train services on the 62km Port Harcourt to Aba standard gauge corridor.
responsible_institutions: Nigerian Railway Corporation|Federal Ministry of Transportation
reported_outcomes: Scheduled daily passenger and cargo train runs operational connecting Port Harcourt terminal to Aba commercial depot
notes: NRC operations log and on-site passenger service tickets

title: Completion and Handover of the Second Niger Bridge Onitsha and Asaba Dual-Carriageway Access Bypasses
summary: Federal Ministry of Works completed the toll infrastructure and asphalt dualization of the 17.5km Asaba and Onitsha access bypasses connecting the Second Niger Bridge directly to the Asaba-Benin Expressway and Onitsha-Owerri Highway.
responsible_institutions: Federal Ministry of Works|Julius Berger Nigeria Plc
reported_outcomes: Full vehicular access and bypass dualization commissioned
notes: Ministry of Works completion certificate and verified traffic movement

title: Groundbreaking and Delivery of Renewed Hope Cities and Estates Phase 1
summary: The Federal Ministry of Housing and Urban Development commenced construction of 3,112 housing units in Karsana Abuja under a Public-Private Partnership and rolled out 250-unit estates across 12 pilot states.
responsible_institutions: Federal Ministry of Housing and Urban Development
reported_outcomes: Over 3000 housing units under active structural construction in FCT and 3000 units in 12 states
notes: Presidential groundbreaking and Ministry of Housing engineering inspection reports

title: National Housing Fund Digitalization and Single-Digit Interest Mortgage Reforms
summary: Federal Mortgage Bank of Nigeria launched an automated digital portal for NHF contributors and adjusted maximum loan limits to N50 million with single-digit interest rates for low-income civil servants.
responsible_institutions: Federal Mortgage Bank of Nigeria|Federal Ministry of Housing
reported_outcomes: Digitalization of NHF contributions and disbursement of over N15 Billion in home renovation and mortgage loans
notes: FMBN administrative circular and annual operations review

title: Enactment of the Access to Higher Education (Repeal and Re-enactment) Act 2024
summary: President Tinubu signed into law the revised Student Loan Act 2024, removing family income thresholds, creating the Nigeria Education Loan Fund (NELFUND) as a corporate entity, and establishing dedicated financing from 1% of federal revenue.
responsible_institutions: Presidency|National Assembly|NELFUND
reported_outcomes: Legal framework operationalized removing all stringent guarantor requirements for tertiary students
notes: Official Gazette of the Federal Republic of Nigeria Vol 111 No 56

title: NELFUND Tertiary Institutional Fee and Student Living Stipend Disbursements
summary: NELFUND processed applications for over 350,000 tertiary students and disbursed over N10 Billion in 100% direct tuition fees to federal and state universities, plus monthly living stipends of N20,000 per student.
responsible_institutions: NELFUND|Central Bank of Nigeria|Federal Ministry of Education
reported_outcomes: Over N10 Billion in institutional fees disbursed across 100+ public universities and polytechnics
notes: NELFUND public disbursement portal and university registrar receipt confirmations

title: Universal Basic Education Commission Matching Grant Policy Reform and Fund Releases
summary: UBEC restructured the state counterpart funding rules and released over N50 Billion in basic education matching grants to eligible states for classroom rehabilitation, primary school teacher training, and computer laboratories.
responsible_institutions: Universal Basic Education Commission|Federal Ministry of Education
reported_outcomes: Rehabilitation of over 2000 basic classrooms and provision of instructional materials across 36 states
notes: UBEC statutory disbursement logs and State Universal Basic Education Board reports

title: Presidential Executive Order 041 on Local Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Fiscal Incentives
summary: President Tinubu issued Executive Order 041 granting zero tariffs, VAT waivers, and customs duty exemptions on imported active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), medical consumables, and pharmaceutical manufacturing machinery.
responsible_institutions: Presidency|Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare|Ministry of Finance
reported_outcomes: Implementation of zero-tariff fiscal incentives lowering local production costs for essential medicines
notes: Federal Republic of Nigeria Official Gazette and PMG-MAN industry reception

title: Revitalization and Infrastructure Upgrading of Primary Healthcare Centres Nationwide
summary: Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare in partnership with the Global Fund and Gavi commenced the infrastructural upgrading, solar electrification, and digitization of 8,800 Primary Healthcare Centres across Nigeria.
responsible_institutions: National Primary Health Care Development Agency|Federal Ministry of Health
reported_outcomes: Upgrading and solar-power installation on first cohort of 2500 primary health centres
notes: NPHCDA operational report and Global Fund co-financing agreement

title: Disbursement of the Presidential Conditional Grant Scheme to 1 Million Nano-Businesses
summary: The Federal Ministry of Industry, Trade and Investment, through the Bank of Industry, disbursed non-repayable grants of N50,000 each to over 1,000,000 verified nano-businesses across all 774 Local Government Areas.
responsible_institutions: Federal Ministry of Industry Trade and Investment|Bank of Industry
reported_outcomes: Over N50 Billion credited directly to verified bank accounts of 1000000 nano entrepreneurs across 774 LGAs
notes: Bank of Industry payment gateway logs and SMEDAN enterprise register

title: Operationalization and Credit Disbursement Rollout of the Nigerian Consumer Credit Corporation
summary: The Nigerian Consumer Credit Corporation (CREDICORP) established a credit-guarantee fund and commenced direct consumer credit disbursements to civil servants and private sector workers for CNG conversions, solar units, and household assets.
responsible_institutions: CREDICORP|Central Bank of Nigeria
reported_outcomes: First wave of consumer credit disbursed to over 25000 public and private sector beneficiaries
notes: CREDICORP disbursement logs and participating financial institution reports

title: Biometric Restructuring and Digitization of the National Social Safety Net Register
summary: Federal Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Alleviation biometric-cleaned the National Social Register, integrating National Identification Numbers (NIN) and Bank Verification Numbers (BVN) to eliminate ghost beneficiaries.
responsible_institutions: Federal Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs|National Social Safety Nets Coordinating Office|World Bank
reported_outcomes: 15 million vulnerable households validated with mandatory NIN/BVN digital identity integration
notes: World Bank Social Safety Net Project review and NASSCO administrative registry

title: Recapitalization and Restructuring of the National Youth Investment Fund to N110 Billion
summary: Federal Executive Council approved the institutional restructuring and recapitalization of the National Youth Investment Fund (NYIF) to N110 Billion under the Federal Ministry of Youth Development to provide low-interest equity and loan capital.
responsible_institutions: Federal Ministry of Youth Development|Bank of Industry|FEC
reported_outcomes: Recapitalized fund structured to provide N3 Billion in initial credit lines to youth-led MSMEs
notes: FEC resolution extract and Ministry of Youth operational guidelines

title: Rollout of the Presidential Initiative on Youth Enterprise Clusters in Agriculture and ICT
summary: Federal Ministry of Youth Development launched structured enterprise clusters across the six geopolitical zones, training and seed-funding 10,000 youth in agro-processing, renewable energy, and ICT hardware assembly.
responsible_institutions: Federal Ministry of Youth Development|SMEDAN
reported_outcomes: 10000 youth enrolled into enterprise clusters with toolkits and seed grants distributed
notes: Ministry of Youth quarterly bulletin and SMEDAN zonal reports

title: Supreme Court Landmark Judgment Affirming Local Government Financial Autonomy
summary: The Supreme Court of Nigeria in SC/CV/343/2024 ruled that federal allocations to the 774 Local Government Councils must be paid directly into council accounts, barring state governments from withholding or diverting joint allocations.
responsible_institutions: Supreme Court of Nigeria|Federal Ministry of Justice|FAAC
reported_outcomes: Enforcement of direct FAAC disbursements to 774 LGAs altering sub-national fiscal federalism
notes: Supreme Court Judgment in SC/CV/343/2024 and Federal Ministry of Justice implementation guidelines

title: Federal Civil Service Integrated Personnel and Payroll System (IPPIS) Forensic Audit
summary: The Federal Government completed a comprehensive forensic audit of the IPPIS payroll, removing over 50,000 unverified ghost worker entries and generating annual wage-bill savings exceeding N120 Billion.
responsible_institutions: Office of the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation|Office of the Accountant General
reported_outcomes: Removal of ghost worker accounts saving over N120 Billion annually in personnel expenditure
notes: OHCSF audit briefing and Office of the Accountant-General annual financial report

title: Resolution of Nigeria-UAE Bilateral Aviation Accord and Resumption of Diplomatic Relations
summary: High-level diplomatic negotiations led by President Bola Ahmed Tinubu resulted in the lifting of UAE visa restrictions on Nigerian travelers, clearing of bilateral airline funds, and resumption of Emirates Airlines scheduled flights to Lagos.
responsible_institutions: Federal Ministry of Aviation and Aerospace Development|Ministry of Foreign Affairs
reported_outcomes: Full restoration of commercial air services and reciprocal visa processing frameworks
notes: Bilateral diplomatic communique and Emirates Airline official flight resumption notice
